_design_note: Prioritized experience replay (Schaul et al. 2016) as the only changed field: agent.replay.sampling uniform -> prioritized. The motivation is measured rather than general. KILLED_OPPONENT is 1.7% of the positive reward this agent sees and 191 times rarer than a coin (section 7.27.2), and prioritization exists for exactly that -- replaying the transitions whose TD error says the value function was surprised, instead of the ones that happen to be numerous. Beta anneals 0.4 -> 1.0 over 513,000 gradient steps, which is the measured gradient-step count of a 5000-round arm on this recipe, so the bias correction finishes as training finishes.

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: agent.replay.sampling: uniform -> prioritized. Every other field is R02_9's.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/m3_lr_decay_5000_vs3rb_20260827/ (R02_9), ten repeats of the holdout classic_versus_opponents suite: score 3.6371, sd 0.1214, coins_share 0.3449. This arm's config is that config with one field changed.
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: Indistinguishable from R02_9 on the tournament suite over ten repeats closes prioritized replay on this line. A drop closes it more firmly: the arm would then be paying variance for a rarity that is not the bottleneck.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: Faster early learning on the loot-crate primary curve. On the tournament score the prediction is weak and stated as such: section 7.32 measured that the agent already values kills correctly -- 0.562 a round against an opponent that does not dodge -- so prioritization would be speeding up something already learned. The budget is also closed at 5000 rounds (section 7.30.4), which is where sample efficiency would otherwise cash out.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training-seed distributions, coins_share and suicides beside every score, and the learning curve on the loot-crate primary suite. Every score names its scenario and whether opponents were present.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: Two arms measured once each need a gap of 0.246 on the tournament suite (section 7.20.2). The quoted comparison is ten repeats per arm of the same fifteen holdout jobs, Welch, |t| > 2.3.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_mechanism_check: The learner records the live importance-sampling exponent and the batch's weights every gradient step. If mean_importance_weight is 1.0 throughout, the prioritization never engaged and the arm is void -- the section 7.29 failure, checked rather than assumed.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_metric_that_decides_it: Official score on classic + 3 rule_based_agent, holdout seeds, ten repeats. That is the competition setting and the only promotion metric.
